Parameters

bounds Rect

The bounds of the pathfinder.

cols int

The amount of columns in the grid.

rows int

The amount of rows in the grid.

requestsPerFrame int

The maximum number of path requests that are handled per frame. Set to 0 or a negative number to handle all incoming path requests.

parallelProcessing bool

If set to true all path request that are handled this frame will be processed in parallel.

initialHelperCapacity int

Sets the initial capacity of all internal helper Collections.

initialAgentCapacity int

Sets the initial capacity of all the agent collection. Set this to a number representing the max number of agents that will be added to this pathfinder.

initialPathRequestCapacity int

Sets the initial capacity of the collection storing path requests.

initialAStarCapacity int

Sets the initial capacity for the used AStar class.

Grid

The grid used by the pathfinder.

public readonly Grid Grid

Field Value

Grid

ParallelProcessing

If true, path requests will be processed in parallel using the thread pool. When enabled, a thread-local AStar instance is used for each worker. Disable to process requests serially on the main thread (uses localAstar).

public bool ParallelProcessing

Field Value

bool

RequestsPerFrame

How many agent requests are handled each frame. If the value is smaller or equal to zero, all incoming requests are handled. This also affects the maximum number of requests that are handled in parallel processing, when ParallelProcessing is true.

public int RequestsPerFrame

GetPath(Vector2, Vector2, uint)

Gets a path from the start to the end position for the given layer.

public Path? GetPath(Vector2 start, Vector2 end, uint layer)

Parameters

start Vector2

The start position.

end Vector2

The end position.

layer uint

The layer to get the path for.

Returns

Path

The path from start to end, or null if no path was found.

Remarks

Path is a pooled classed. Instances should be returned to the pool via ReturnPath(Path) or ReturnInstance() when no longer needed. Returned instances should not be accessed afterwards.

GetPathAsync(Vector2, Vector2, uint, CancellationToken)

Asynchronously finds a path between two world positions using A* on this pathfinder. The start and end positions are clamped to the pathfinder bounds. If the clamped start or end cell is not traversable, the nearest traversable cell will be used; if none is available the method returns null. Using the async version makes sense when pathfinding may take a long time, e.g. on large grids or very complex paths.

public Task<Path?> GetPathAsync(Vector2 start, Vector2 end, uint layer, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

Parameters

start Vector2

Start world position.

end Vector2

End world position.

layer uint

Traversal layer used for weight and traversability checks.

cancellationToken CancellationToken

Cancellation token to cancel the pathfinding operation.

Returns

Task<Path>

A task that completes with the found Path or null if no path exists or valid traversable start/end cells could not be found.

Remarks

Path is a pooled classed. Instances should be returned to the pool via ReturnPath(Path) or ReturnInstance() when no longer needed. Returned instances should not be accessed afterwards.

GetPathsParallel(List<(Vector2 start, Vector2 end, uint layer)>, CancellationToken)

Executes multiple pathfinding requests in parallel and returns an array of results. Each element in the returned array corresponds to the request at the same index in requests. Returns null if requests is empty or if the operation was cancelled.

public Path?[]? GetPathsParallel(List<(Vector2 start, Vector2 end, uint layer)> requests, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

Parameters

requests List<(Vector2 start, Vector2 end, uint layer)>

A list of tuples where each tuple contains the start position, end position and traversal layer.

cancellationToken CancellationToken

Optional cancellation token to cancel the parallel operation.

Returns

Path[]

An array of Path? results matching the request order, or null if no requests were provided or the operation was cancelled.

Remarks

Path is a pooled class. Instances should be returned to the pool via ReturnPath(Path) or ReturnInstance() when no longer needed. Returned instances should not be accessed afterward.
